---
description: "Use when creating or editing third-party integration guides in content/guides/: lighter review, no navigation entry, shared docs conventions, and authors."
applyTo: "content/guides/**/*.md"
---

# Integration guides (content/guides/)

- Guides are community and third-party contributions showing how to use Neon with other technologies, frameworks, and services.
- They go through a lighter review process than core docs in content/docs/.
- Do not add guides to content/docs/navigation.yaml; they are surfaced through their own index.
- Follow the same frontmatter and writing style conventions as content/docs/ unless a guide contributor has a specific format.
- Author profiles live in content/guides/authors/.
